defs.def: connected with a corporation 公司的

ex.s: Similarly, the corporate world has certainly known its fair share of disruption, yet it is only in the last couple of decades that the “Disruptor” has become a recognisable figure in the way we talk about big business.
ex.t: 类似地，企业界当然也经历过不少颠覆，但“颠覆者”成为我们谈论大企业时一个可辨识的角色，不过是近几十年的事。

ex.s: It's not just corporate jobs, or even paid work that can help keep your brain fit, Then points out.
ex.t: 滕指出，不只是公司工作，甚至有偿工作也能帮助保持大脑健康。

ex.s: gain corporate benefit     D. help communities in need
ex.t: 获得企业利益　D. 帮助有需要的社区

ex.s: For example, "Japanese was a minor subject I took and I know that expanding into Japan is part of your corporate plan.
ex.t: 例如，“日语是我修过的一门辅修课，我知道拓展日本市场是你们公司计划的一部分。”

defs.def: forming a corporation 组成公司（或团体）的；法人的
involving or shared by all the members of a group 社团的；全体的；共同的
